title_zh: 调整了网站日志
message: Label site-log data files and reword the restore entry
story_zh: 更新了网站日志的归档数据，使页面读到的记录与最新一次改动保持一致。
story_en: Updated the archived data behind Site Log so the page shows the records from the latest change.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Label site-log data files and reword the restore entry
details_zh: 调整网站日志的归档内容、呈现方式或自动记录。
details_en: Refined the site-log archive, presentation, or automatic record.

title_zh: 展开与收起全部日期
message: Bind the expand/collapse control after the archive is parsed
story_zh: 修复了资讯页的“展开/收起全部日期”按钮，该功能用于一次性展开或收起所有归档日期。
story_en: Fixed the Opportunities page's button that expands or folds every archived day at once.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Bind the expand/collapse control after the archive is parsed
details_zh: 控件脚本原先在归档渲染完成前执行、没有绑上事件；改为文档解析后再绑定，并在点击时按需查询日期块。
details_en: The control's script ran before the archive was parsed and bound nothing; it now binds after parsing and looks the day panels up on click.

title_zh: 资讯按日折叠与日志描述
message: Fold the opportunities archive by day and make log entries specific
story_zh: 对资讯页的归档方式进行了改动，使每天抓取的内容按日留存并默认收起；同时使日志描述写明具体改动。
story_en: Changed the Opportunities archive so each day's items are kept by date and folded closed, and made site-log entries name the concrete change.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Fold the opportunities archive by day and make log entries specific
details_zh: 每一天改为可折叠块、新增展开/收起全部按钮；采集脚本运行前先归一化归档（同日合并、日内去重）。
details_en: Each day became a collapsible block with an expand/collapse-all control; the collector normalises the archive before adding to it.

title_zh: 网站日志条目补录
message: Restore the entry for the expand/collapse fix
story_zh: 对网站日志的归档数据进行了补充，使“展开/收起全部日期”那条改动重新出现在记录中。
story_en: Restored the missing entry in the site-log archive so the expand/collapse fix appears in the record again.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Restore the entry for the expand/collapse fix
details_zh: 补回被合并冲突丢掉的 b6622dd 条目，并修正日志数据的字段归类。
details_en: Re-added the b6622dd entry dropped by a merge conflict and corrected how site-log data files are labelled.

title_zh: 调整了每日新闻
message: Merge the news stories that only existed in the local copy
story_zh: 对每日新闻的采集与归档脚本进行了改动，使每日内容按日留存、重复条目不再重复入库。
story_en: Changed the collection and archiving script behind Daily News so daily items are kept by date and duplicates are stored once.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Merge the news stories that only existed in the local copy
details_zh: 调整每日新闻的归档内容、呈现方式或自动更新。
details_en: Refined the daily-news archive, presentation, or automatic update.

title_zh: 导航栏间距与切换按钮
message: Make the language pill a seventh nav item and even out all the gaps
story_zh: 对导航栏的排布方式进行了改动，使菜单项与双语切换按钮之间的间距在任意宽度下都相等。
story_en: Changed how the navigation row is distributed so the gaps between menu items and the language pill are equal at every width.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Make the language pill a seventh nav item and even out all the gaps
details_zh: 双语切换按钮改为第 7 个参与排布的项，整行用 space-between 分布；修复主题 margin 泄漏造成的 EN 选项错位。
details_en: The pill became the row's seventh item under space-between; fixed a theme margin leak that had offset the EN option.

title_zh: 导航标签按内容宽度
message: Size nav labels by content so Opportunities stops being clipped
story_zh: 对导航标签的宽度规则进行了改动，使 Opportunities 等长标签不再被截断为省略号。
story_en: Changed nav labels to take their content width so long labels such as Opportunities are no longer truncated.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Size nav labels by content so Opportunities stops being clipped
details_zh: 移除六等分模型（每份宽度由最宽标签决定，中段宽度会裁字），改为按内容宽度排布并整组居中。
details_en: Replaced the equal-shares model, where the widest label bounded every share and got clipped at mid-range widths, with content sizing and a centred group.

title_zh: 调整了资讯、导航、界面样式
message: Add Opportunities page with daily internship and academia collectors
story_zh: 新增资讯页面，用于汇总实习与海外高校交流资讯；接入每日自动采集，使信息按日归档、无需手动维护。
story_en: Added an Opportunities page that gathers internships and academic-exchange news, backed by daily automatic collection.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Add Opportunities page with daily internship and academia collectors
details_zh: 新增中英双语资讯页与导航入口，实习板块区分联合国与企业两类来源；添加去重归档脚本与每日定时采集工作流。
details_en: Added the bilingual Opportunities page with a navigation entry, split UN and company internship boards, plus deduping collection scripts and a daily workflow.

title_zh: 调整了学习札记、界面样式
message: Add CiteSpace download/install study note to Research Methods
story_zh: 新增 CiteSpace 下载与安装教程札记，覆盖官方入口与 2026 年订阅制变化，使读者入门少走弯路。
story_en: Added a CiteSpace download-and-install guide covering official sources and the 2026 subscription change, making setup easier to follow.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Add CiteSpace download/install study note to Research Methods
details_zh: 在学习札记新增中英双语教程文章，收录官方下载入口、安装步骤与付费订阅说明。
details_en: Added bilingual guide posts under Study Notes with official download links, setup steps, and subscription notes.

title_zh: 论文信息密码导出
message: Add password-protected publications export feature
story_zh: 增加了论文发表的导出功能，该功能用于在密码校验后查看并导出完整的论文信息汇总。
story_en: Added a publications export, which shows and exports the full publication summary after a password check.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
details_zh: 论文发表页新增导出按钮与密码弹窗，汇总卡片中的标题、期刊、年份与分区信息。
details_en: Added an export button and password dialog to the Publications page, summarising title, venue, year and category.

title_zh: 每日新闻中文标题
message: Backfill Chinese titles into daily news archive
story_zh: 对每日新闻归档进行了补充，使历史条目的中文标题与英文标题一并完整显示。
story_en: Backfilled the daily-news archive so older entries show their Chinese titles alongside the English ones.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Backfill Chinese titles into daily news archive
details_zh: 为归档中的历史条目补齐中文标题字段，页面按语言选择显示对应标题。
details_en: Added the missing Chinese title field to archived entries; the page shows the title matching the language.

title_zh: 导航选中态与首页简介
title_en: Nav selected state and home intro
message: Clarify navigation state and compact home intro
story_zh: 对导航栏的选中样式与首页简介进行了改动，使当前所在页面更明确、首屏文字更紧凑。
story_en: Changed the navigation's selected styling and the home intro so the current page is clearer and the first screen more compact.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Clarify navigation state and compact home intro
details_zh: 调整 masthead 选中态样式，精简中英首页简介段落。
details_en: Adjusted the masthead selected-state styling and shortened the bilingual home intro.

title_zh: 网站日志按日期分组
message: Rebalance home and group site log by date
story_zh: 对网站日志的呈现方式进行了改动，使多条更新按日期归组、并可按年份与月份筛选。
story_en: Changed how the site log is presented so updates are grouped by date and can be filtered by year and month.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Rebalance home and group site log by date
details_zh: 日志页按日期分组展示，归档筛选器扩展为支持年份与月份。
details_en: The log page now groups entries by date, and the archive filter supports year and month.

title_zh: 首页读起来更轻松
story_zh: 首页的信息有些挤。我重新安排了正文宽度和新闻卡片，让介绍、新闻与研究兴趣各自拥有清楚的节奏。
story_en: The home page felt crowded, so I rebalanced its text width and news cards to give each section a clearer rhythm.
message: Refine desktop homepage information hierarchy

title_zh: 首页只留下需要的内容
story_zh: 首页不必像一份完整简历。我移除了重复的教育板块，让个人介绍和研究兴趣成为真正的主角。
story_en: The home page does not need to read like a full CV. I removed the repeated education section so the introduction and research interests could lead.
message: Remove Education section from home pages

title_zh: 把世界装进一个小窗口
title_en: A small window onto the world
story_zh: 为了更好地了解世界上发生了什么，我加入了每日新闻：每小时更新，并把简讯按日期安静地保存下来。
story_en: To keep a closer eye on the world, I added Daily News: an hourly briefing with a date-by-date archive.
message: Add automated daily global news briefing

title_zh: 论文可以按年份寻找了
story_zh: 成果渐渐多起来后，逐张翻找并不轻松。我加入了年份筛选，让不同阶段的论文更快被找到。
story_en: As the publication list grew, browsing every card became slow. A year filter now makes each period easier to find.
message: Add year filter to publications pages

title_zh: 卡片开始回应点击
story_zh: 学习札记的三张卡片现在可以展开；网站日志的每条记录也有了直达修改入口。需要操作的地方终于会给出回应。
story_en: The three Study Notes cards can now expand, and every site-log entry has a direct edit route. Interactive areas finally respond as expected.
message: Add per-entry edit links to site log and expandable study-note cards

title_zh: 重新介绍自己
story_zh: 我重新整理了首页文字，用更直接的方式说明自己的身份、研究兴趣，以及这个网站准备记录什么。
story_en: I rewrote the home introduction to state more directly who I am, what I study, and what this website will hold.
message: Update homepage intro copy

title_zh: 网站开始记住自己的变化
story_zh: 我加入了双语网站日志，也整理了学习札记。页面不只展示结果，也开始保存它一步步长成的过程。
story_en: I added a bilingual Site Log and refined Study Notes, allowing the website to preserve how it grows rather than only showing the result.
message: Add bilingual site log and refine notes

title_zh: 小修改也会被记录
title_en: Even small changes leave a trace
story_zh: 为了不遗漏日常调整，我让网站日志能够读取更新记录，并把内容页的宽度、留白和圆角重新对齐。
story_en: To keep everyday refinements from disappearing, I connected the log to site updates and aligned the width, spacing, and corners of content pages.
message: Align content pages and automate site log

title_zh: 导航和内容有了新的秩序
title_en: A new order for navigation and content
story_zh: 原来的导航和内容分布不够清楚。我重新安排了间距，加入卡片式设计，也让期刊标签更醒目。
story_en: The navigation and content distribution lacked clarity, so I reworked the spacing, introduced cards, and made publication badges easier to notice.
message: Refine homepage layout, language switch, and publication badges

title_zh: 语言按钮真正动了起来
story_zh: 中英文切换曾经更像一枚静态按钮。我把它改成可操作的分段开关，并让每个页面都通往对应译文。
story_en: The language control once looked more active than it was. I turned it into a true segmented switch and paired every page with its translation.
message: Make language selector truly interactive

title_zh: 手机端不再需要左右寻找
title_en: No more sideways searching on mobile
story_zh: 手机端曾出现横向滚动，语言开关也跑到屏幕外。我重新排列了导航、人物卡片和正文，让内容回到一列之中。
story_en: Mobile pages once scrolled sideways and pushed the language switch off-screen. I rebuilt the navigation, profile card, and content into one clean column.
message: Fix mobile home layout and navigation

title_zh: 为学习札记留出三扇门
story_zh: 我建立了研究方法、智能传播和全球传播三个栏目，也预留了上传文件与添加链接的入口。
story_en: I created three spaces for Research Methods, Intelligent Communication, and Global Communication, with routes for files and links.
message: Refine publications and add study note hub

title_zh: 论文卡片更适合阅读了
title_en: Publication cards become easier to read
story_zh: 论文信息被重新压缩和分组：每行两张卡片，标题更克制，分区标签固定在容易看到的位置。
story_en: Publication information was regrouped into two compact cards per row, with quieter titles and consistently placed ranking badges.
message: Refine publication reading experience

title_zh: 人物面板终于看得清了
title_en: A profile panel with clearer contrast
story_zh: 深色人物面板曾让文字和图标显得含混。我提升了对比度，并为论文卡片换上更协调的自然风景。
story_en: Text and icons once faded into the dark profile panel. I improved the contrast and paired publication cards with calmer landscape imagery.
message: Improve profile contrast and publication covers

title_zh: 创建了这个网站
story_zh: 创建了本网站。初版设计包括中英双语首页、个人信息面板、论文发表、学习札记，以及一套黑白灰的视觉系统。
story_en: I created this website. Its first edition included bilingual home pages, a profile panel, Publications, Study Notes, and a black-white-gray visual system.
message: Document the site design system
